title: astroloma xerophyllum
intro: Astroloma xerophyllum, commonly known as the "dry mountain astroloma", is a flowering plant species native to Western Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Astroloma xerophyllum include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antifungal activities. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
